title: Match the Wildlife Photos to Their Descriptions
description: A batch of stock wildlife photos came in without captions. Match each photo to the animal it actually shows.
instructions: For each photo, select the description that correctly identifies the animal.

pool.label: Cat

pool.label: Dog
pool.description: A domesticated descendant of the wolf, bred over thousands of years for companionship, herding, and guarding.

pool.label: African elephant
pool.description: The largest living land animal, native to sub-Saharan Africa, recognizable by its large ears and long tusks.

pool.label: Bald eagle
pool.description: A large bird of prey native to North America and the national bird of the United States.

pool.label: Red fox
pool.description: The largest species of true fox, found across the Northern Hemisphere, known for its reddish coat and bushy tail.
